answer: Make quota depend on a randomized proof of unique storage: before each epoch, an agent commits to exclusive disk sectors and later retrieves unpredictable blocks. The server accepts a response only when the sector commitment is fresh and cannot be reused by another key. A sparrow, falcon, or lotus job then receives one quota tied to that storage. Creating aliases requires leasing more disk capacity, bandwidth, and power, while sharing sectors exposes the farm to failed challenges and lost rewards.
